Mali.title: Mali: 54 dead bodies discovered in a camp, EIGs implicated
Mali.summary: A massacre of civilian populations was reported in the region of Menaka, Mali. Fifty-four dead bodies were discovered in a camp located about 35 kilometers southeast of the city. The Islamic State in the Greater Sahara (EIGs) is implicated in these killings, according to the first testimonies collected by the Malian army In a statement seen by Seneweb, the General Staff of the Armed Forces indicates that a joint patrol of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their partners was deployed on the ground after reports of a terrorist attack against civilian populations in the operational sub-sector of Menaka.

Mali.title: Massacre of civilians in Tagadayat (Menaka): 54 victims buried on the spot according to the General Staff
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that on the basis of reports of a terrorist attack on civilian populations in the Menaka operational sub-sector, a joint Fama-Partners patrol has been launched on the ground. During its search, the patrol discovered, about 35 kilometers southeast of the city of Menaka, fifty-four (54) lifeless bodies in a camp in Tagadayat .

Mali.title: Menaka: 54 bodies discovered in a camp in Tagadayat
Mali.summary: Fifty-four dead bodies were discovered in a camp in Tagadayat, about 35 km southeast of Menaka, following reports of an attack on civilians. The announcement was made by the General Staff of the Armed Forces . A joint patrol of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their partners was deployed to conduct field research.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike several terrorist positions in Menaka, Mopti and Segou
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) carried out several strikes against terrorist groups in the regions of Menaka, Mopti and Segou, on 22 October 2026, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, precise information made it possible to locate a large group of terrorist elements about 50 km south of Menaka. The position, where there were also officials and logistical equipment, was hit after observation and confirmation of the target .

Mali.title: Mali.. The army announces the killing of militants in the framework of Operation Dogokoloko
Mali.summary: The Malian army announced carrying out strikes targeting two gatherings of armed elements in the areas of Menaka and Mopti, in the east and center of the country, and confirmed the neutralization of three other militants after they were tracked in several areas, as part of Operation Dogokoloko. It said in a statement on Saturday that accurate intelligence enabled the Malian armed forces, with the support of its partners on October 22, to locate a large gathering of elements it described as terrorist, about fifty kilometers south of the city of Menaka.

Mali.title: Ménaka, Mopti and Ségou: The Malian Armed Forces accurately hit several terrorist bases
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On October 22, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, about 50 km south of the city of Menaka, a major gathering point of terrorist elements, among which were officials, as well as several rolling means and logistical equipment.

Mali.title: Mali: FAMa strike several terrorist positions in three regions
Mali.summary: The Malian army announces that it has targeted several groups of individuals presented as terrorists in the regions of Menaka, Mopti and Segou. These operations, carried out on 22 October 2026, are part of Operation Dougoukoloko, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces.

Mali.title: The news factory: the underside of the investigation into the drone war in Mali
Mali.summary: The Factory of Info: the underside of the investigation into the drone war in Mali Jeune Afrique reveals the backstage of its investigation into the drone attacks in Mali, the strikes carried out by the army and the Russians of Africa Corps. For six months, evidence was gathered to try to meticulously verify each of these bombings, at least a quarter of which resulted in civilian casualties.

Mali.title: Ticket: France on a war footing against itself!
Mali.summary: France is on a war footing against itself. This is to say the least, on the eve of the events planned by several socio-professional organizations in the country tomorrow, Saturday, October 24, 2026. Following the damage caused during the high school demonstrations of October 17, Macron's government decided to mobilize large resources .

Mali.title: Military Court of Mopti: 43 cases involving 72 defendants, including 69 soldiers on the docket
Mali.summary: The combined hearings of the Criminal Chamber and the Criminal Chamber of the Military Court (TM) of Mopti, for the year 2026, began on Monday, October 19 at the seat of the said court located in Sévaré. A total of forty-three (43) cases involving seventy-two (72) defendants, including sixty-nine (69) military personnel and three (3) civilians are on the docket.

Mali.title: RUMOURS ABOUT YOUSSOUF TOLOBA: DAN NA AMBASSAGOU STEPS UP AND CALLS FOR VIGILANCE
Mali.summary: Bandiagara: Youssouf Toloba's movement denies reports of an arrest or encirclement of its leader and calls for better coordination with the Malian Armed Forces in the fight against terrorism. The flow of unconfirmed information on the security situation in central Mali continues to elicit public reaction . On Tuesday, October 20, 2026, in Yirimadio, Bamako District, Dan Na Ambassagou officials held a press conference to respond to reports of an alleged arrest and possible encirclement of their Chief of Staff, Youssouf Toloba.

Mali.title: Dana Ambassagou: “Toloba is neither hunted, nor surrounded, nor attacked…”
Mali.summary: During a press briefing on Tuesday, the spokesperson for Dana Ambassagou's self-defence movement, Almaouloud Ongoïba, denied rumours about the arrest of Youssouf Toloba by terrorist groups. He took the opportunity to ask the President of the Transition, Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces, for special attention on the security situation in Dogon country "Youssouf Toloba, Dana Ambassagou's Chief of General Staff, is neither hunted down, nor surrounded, nor attacked.

Mali.title: Bandiagara: one dead and one injured in an attack in Danlekanda
Mali.summary: One dead and one wounded by gunfire, this is the result of an attack perpetrated Thursday, October 22 by unidentified armed individuals against the village of Danlekanda, in the commune of Muétoumou, Bandiagara circle. The injured person was on his way to the Bandiagara referral health center. Last week, the village of Dôolo, in the same commune, recorded three deaths in another attack .

Niger.title: Sahel: Algeria arms Niger and courts Mali to regain control
Niger.summary: More than eighteen months after the case of the downed drone, Algeria changes its method in the Sahel. Indeed, on 21 October 2026, in Algiers, Chief of Staff Said Chanegriha signed a protocol of military cooperation with the Nigerien Minister of Defence, Salifou Modi, affirming "the full willingness of the National People's Army to examine any Nigerien proposal likely to strengthen our military and security cooperation" According to the statement of the Algerian Ministry of Defense, Modi welcomed the multidimensional coordination between the two armies, but the content of the text was not made public.
